```{=html}
<script>
// Move dark-mode toggle next to intro links
(function () {
  var toggle = document.querySelector('.quarto-color-scheme-toggle');
  var row = document.querySelector('.linkrow p') || document.querySelector('.linkrow');
  if (toggle && row) {
    // muted "·" separating the links from the toggle
    var sep = document.createElement('span');
    sep.className = 'linkrow-sep';
    sep.textContent = '·';
    row.appendChild(sep);
    row.appendChild(toggle);
  }
})();
</script>
```

```{=html}
<script>
```
```{=html}
// Make the email copy-able:
(function () {
  var box = document.querySelector('.email-copy');
  if (!box) return;
  var icon = box.querySelector('.email-copy-btn i');
  var addr = box.querySelector('.email-copy-addr');
  var timer;

  // Fall back to the old select+execCommand 
  function copyText(text) {
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    }
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text;
      ta.setAttribute('readonly', '');
      ta.style.position = 'fixed';
      ta.style.opacity = '0';
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      var ok = false;
      try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) { ok = false; }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
      ok ? resolve() : reject();
    });
  }

  // Swap the copy icon for another one for a moment, then revert it
  function flash(iconClass, tip, ms) {
    icon.className = iconClass;
    box.title = tip;
    box.classList.add('is-copied');
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(function () {
      icon.className = 'bi bi-copy';
      box.title = 'Click to copy';
      box.classList.remove('is-copied');
    }, ms);
  }

  box.addEventListener('click', function () {
    copyText(box.dataset.email).then(function () {
      flash('bi bi-check2', 'Copied!', 1800);
    }).catch(function () {
      var range = document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(addr);
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      sel.addRange(range);
      flash('bi bi-exclamation-circle', 'Press Ctrl+C to copy', 2600);
    });
  });
})();
</script>
```
